verses.gurmukhi: ਲੀਹਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਚਲੀਐ ਜਿਉ ਗਾਡੀ ਰਾਹੁ।
verses.translit_en: leehaa a(n)dhar chaleeaai jiau gaaddee raahu|

en.bdb: As, a coach on the highway goes through the beaten tracks,
In the holy congregation one goes on abiding with the divine ordinance (hukam) and will of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਧਨ ਸੋਘਾ ਰਖਦਾ ਘਰਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਹੁ।
verses.translit_en: jiau dhan soghaa rakhadhaa ghar a(n)dhar saahu|

en.bdb: As, the wise person keeps money intact at home

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਿਰਜਾਦ ਨ ਛਡਈ ਸਾਇਰੁ ਅਸਗਾਹੁ।
verses.translit_en: jiau mirajaadh na chhaddiee sair asagaahu|

en.bdb: And the deep ocean leaves not its general nature;
As the grass is trampled under the feet,

verses.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮਸਾਲ ਹੈ ਮਾਨਸਰੁ ਹੰਸ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਵਾਹੁ।
verses.translit_en: dharamasaal hai maanasar ha(n)s gursikh vaahu|

en.bdb: Like this (earth) inn is the Manasarovar and the disciples of the Guru are swans

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਖਾਹੁ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit_en: ratan padhaarath gur sabadh kar keeratan khaahu ||14||

en.bdb: Who in the form of kirtan, singing of the holy hymns, eat the pearls of the Word of the Guru.
